title: Crispi Chicken Cutlets in Velvet Mushroom Gravy
description: Thin chicken cutlets bake over a smooth mushroom gravy.
equipment: Ninja Crispi, 4-qt glass container and adapter

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breast cutlets
ingredients.note: Tenderize to an even ½-inch thickness.

steps.title: Soften mushrooms
steps.text: Finely dice {mush} and cook in the HexClad with a splash of water for 5 minutes, until soft.

steps.title: Simmer the sauce
steps.text: Whisk {broth}, {milk}, {thyme} into the HexClad. Simmer gently for 5 minutes and blend smooth with an immersion blender.

steps.title: Thicken
steps.text: Whisk {starch} with {cold}, then stir into the simmering sauce for 1 minute until it coats a spoon.

steps.title: Prepare the dish
steps.text: Start with the room-temperature 4-qt glass container, no crisper plate. Let sauce cool to lukewarm before adding to the glass. Spread the sauce over the base.

steps.title: Prepare the chicken
steps.text: Tenderize {breast} to a uniform ½ inch and divide into two cutlets.

steps.title: Cook in sauce
steps.text: Nestle the pieces in the sauce in a single layer. Fit the 4-qt adapter and PowerPod and select Bake. Cook for 13–20 minutes, checking the thickest piece early. Finish at 165°F in the center.

steps.title: Serve generously
steps.text: Spoon hot sauce over each serving.

notes: Make ahead: prepare the sauce a day ahead and refrigerate separately. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Freeze cooked portions with sauce, cooled within 2 hours, for up to 2 months. Fridge reheat: cover and warm gently with a spoonful of water to 165°F. Freezer reheat: thaw overnight in the fridge, then reheat covered to 165°F. Option A uses the listed seasonings. For gentler Option B, omit added citrus, vinegar or chile where used. Pass additional heat at the table. Dairy swap: use unsweetened oat milk and equivalent plain dairy-free cheese if needed. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 183 kcal, 30.7 g protein, 6.0 g total carbohydrate, 3.4 g fat, 0.6 g fiber, 77 mg sodium.
